text:
Maya: Quick nit from recent tests 1: the small 'KMS' badge on Instances is ambiguous. Trial users think BYOK is on by default.
Sam: Can we make the badge explicit about provider + management type? e.g. 'AWS KMS  customer-managed' or 'AWS KMS  platform-managed'
Maya: Yes. Also the alias vs key-id confusion keeps coming up. Alias should be visible; full key id behind a disclosure.
Devon: Accessibility: the tooltip currently relies on hover. We need a keyboard-focusable disclosure (chevron) with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Aisha: Security suggestion: always show key authority (AWS/GCP/Azure) and a short label for ownership. For customer-managed keys we must show alias and last rotation timestamp in the disclosure.
Sam: UX mock idea: badge line1 = "Encryption  AWS KMS" line2 (muted) = "alias/my-service-key". Focus or click opens a small popover with: provider, alias, full key id (masked), last rotation, and a copy action for key id.
Oliver: Audit logs: we have inconsistent phrasing across features ("encryption key updated" vs "KMS key rotated"). Propose a canonical pattern: "[actor] [verb] [resource]  from [old] to [new] (ISO tz)" and a verb whitelist: created, attached, detached, rotated, updated, deleted.
Maya: Retention presets: current labels 'Short/Default/Long' confused users. Quick fix: show durations inline e.g. 'Short (7d)', 'Default (30d)', 'Long (365d)'. Make sure durations are exposed to screen readers via sr-only text or aria-describedby.
Devon: Implementation note: disclosure popover will be absolutely positioned and animated via transform to avoid layout shift in compact lists. We'll mask the key id except when user expands and presses copy.
Aisha: MUST for audits: log previous_value and actor for all retention changes. Right now only new value is recorded which is not sufficient for investigations.
Sam: Action list: 1) Update badge to 'Encryption (AWS KMS  customer-managed)' + show alias. 2) Add keyboard-focusable disclosure to reveal masked key id + rotation ts + copy. 3) Retention presets show durations inline + sr-only descriptions. 4) Standardize audit copy using verb whitelist and include previous_value.
Maya: I'll update the Figma screens and add accessibility annotations.
Devon: I'll prototype the popover and share a short gif. Will confirm no reflow occurs.
Oliver: I'll draft the audit copy examples and add them to the infra style guide. Example: "Frank rotated KMS key for Instance prod-01  from alias/old-key to alias/new-key (2025-03-12T15:03:00-07:00)"
ux-bot: Reminder  design review sync Fri 10:00. Added to the agenda.
